recommendation.text: The Board recommends that the Administration, in coordination with relevant stakeholders and entities, conduct a comprehensive review of all established and temporary posts under the regular budget with differences between operational and budgetary data over a period of more than one year to ensure that budgetary submissions accurately reflect the actual functions and grades of the respective positions.
